# OpenVPN

> OpenVPN makes business VPN and Zero Trust access products built on the open-source OpenVPN protocol: Access Server, a self-hosted VPN, and CloudConnexa, a cloud-delivered VPN service. The free OpenVPN Connect app is the client for both.

Product documentation lives in four docs projects. Each has its own llms.txt that lists every page as Markdown (see Documentation below).

## Site

- [Homepage](https://openvpn.net/): Connect any user, device, or network with OpenVPN's trusted security platform and Zero Trust VPN business offering.

## Products

- [Access Server](https://openvpn.net/access-server/): Detailed information on the features and benefits of self-hosted business VPN OpenVPN Access Server.
- [CloudConnexa](https://openvpn.net/cloud-vpn/): Detailed information on the features and benefits of cloud-delivered business VPN OpenVPN CloudConnexa.

### Features

- [Access Server Features](https://openvpn.net/access-server/features/): Review the full self-hosted business VPN Access Server feature set for granular controls.
- [Access Server Access Control](https://openvpn.net/access-server/features/access-control/): Implement granular role-based policies to control user, group, and network access.
- [Access Server Authentication Systems](https://openvpn.net/access-server/features/authentication-systems/): Integrate LDAP, RADIUS, SAML, and other identity providers for centralized authentication.
- [Access Server Data Channel Offload](https://openvpn.net/access-server/features/data-channel-offload/): Accelerate VPN throughput with kernel-level Data Channel Offload (DCO) technology.
- [Access Server Fast Installation](https://openvpn.net/access-server/features/fast-installation/): Deploy Access Server in minutes using automated installers and marketplace images.
- [Access Server VPN Deployment](https://openvpn.net/access-server/features/vpn-deployment/): Explore flexible deployment options across on-prem, cloud, and virtual environments.
- [Access Server Plugins](https://openvpn.net/as-docs/plugins/): Extend Access Server authentication with post-authentication scripts, such as MFA or other custom checks.
- [CloudConnexa Cyber Shield](https://openvpn.net/cloud-vpn/cyber-shield/): Block malware and risky domains with built-in DNS and content filtering.
- [CloudConnexa Features](https://openvpn.net/cloud-vpn/features/): Review the full CloudConnexa feature set for secure remote access and ZTNA.
- [CloudConnexa Cloud Security](https://openvpn.net/cloud-vpn/features/cloud-security/): Protect cloud workloads with private connectivity and zero-trust access policies.
- [CloudConnexa Flexible Routing](https://openvpn.net/cloud-vpn/features/flexible-routing/): Configure custom routing rules to optimize traffic between users, sites, and clouds.
- [CloudConnexa Full Mesh Topology](https://openvpn.net/cloud-vpn/features/full-mesh-topology/): Automatically create a global full-mesh overlay connecting every user and network.
- [CloudConnexa Internet Gateway](https://openvpn.net/cloud-vpn/features/internet-gateway/): Provide secure internet egress with geolocated gateways and traffic inspection.
- [CloudConnexa IoT Security](https://openvpn.net/cloud-vpn/features/iot-security/): Isolate and monitor IoT devices with identity-based segmentation and least-privilege access.
- [CloudConnexa IPSEC](https://openvpn.net/cloud-vpn/features/ipsec/): Connect existing IPsec gateways to CloudConnexa for seamless hybrid networking.

## Documentation

- [Access Server docs](https://openvpn.net/as-docs/llms.txt): Index of every Access Server docs page in Markdown: installation, configuration, authentication, tunneling and the REST API, for versions 2.x and 3.x.
- [CloudConnexa docs](https://openvpn.net/cloud-docs/llms.txt): Index of every CloudConnexa docs page in Markdown: owner, administrator, user and developer guides, tutorials and the API reference.
- [OpenVPN Connect docs](https://openvpn.net/connect-docs/llms.txt): Index of every OpenVPN Connect docs page in Markdown: the client apps on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.
- [Community docs](https://openvpn.net/community-docs/llms.txt): Index of every Community docs page in Markdown: the open-source OpenVPN 2.x and 3.x manuals, how-tos, community articles and FAQs.
- [CloudConnexa Quick Start Guide](https://openvpn.net/cloud-docs/owner/get-started/start-using-cloudconnexa/): A guide to quickly get started with CloudConnexa cloud-delivered business VPN from OpenVPN.

## Solutions

- [Secure IoT Communications](https://openvpn.net/use-cases/iot/): Explore how OpenVPN secures IoT communications.
- [Protect Access to SaaS Apps](https://openvpn.net/use-cases/saas-and-cloud-protection/): Learn how OpenVPN protects access to Software as a Service applications.
- [Site-to-Site Networking](https://openvpn.net/use-cases/site-to-site-vpn/): Information on establishing secure site-to-site connections using OpenVPN.
- [Secure DNS](https://openvpn.net/use-cases/dns-security-and-content-filtering/): Details on how OpenVPN ensures secure DNS queries.
- [Restricted Internet Access](https://openvpn.net/use-cases/restricted-internet-access/): Learn about implementing restricted internet access with OpenVPN.
- [zero trust VPN](https://openvpn.net/use-cases/zero-trust-network-access/): Information on zero trust VPN architecture and its benefits.
- [remote access VPN](https://openvpn.net/use-cases/secure-remote-access/): Details on remote access VPN solutions provided by OpenVPN.
- [Business VPN](https://openvpn.net/use-cases/business-vpn/): Explore the features and advantages of OpenVPN's business VPN solutions.

## Industries

- [Technology](https://openvpn.net/industries/technology/): Deploy robust, reliable, enterprise-grade network security without slowing down innovation and cross-functional teamwork.
- [Healthcare](https://openvpn.net/industries/healthcare/): Meet HIPAA requirements and secure patient health information with end-to-end encryption and detailed access controls for medical systems.
- [Financial services](https://openvpn.net/industries/financial-services/): Meet PCI-DSS requirements, and secure customer financial data with application-level controls and HSM integration for critical operations.
- [Energy](https://openvpn.net/industries/energy/): Secure SCADA systems and remote assets while meeting NERC CIP compliance.
- [Engineering](https://openvpn.net/industries/engineering/): Enable secure collaboration and file sharing across distributed engineering teams.
- [Manufacturing](https://openvpn.net/industries/manufacturing/): Protect production networks and IIoT devices with always-on encrypted connectivity.
- [Retail and Entertainment](https://openvpn.net/industries/retail-and-entertainment/): Safeguard POS systems and guest Wi-Fi across multi-site retail and entertainment venues.
- [View all industry solutions](https://openvpn.net/industries/): Explore various industry-specific solutions offered by OpenVPN.
- [VPN For Small Business](https://openvpn.net/small-business/): Tailored VPN solutions for small business requirements.

## Conversion Pages

- [Start a Trial for Free](https://myaccount.openvpn.com/signup): Initiate a free trial of OpenVPN's services.
- [Book a Demo](https://go.openvpn.net/book-a-demo): Schedule a demonstration of OpenVPN's solutions.
- [Sign In](https://myaccount.openvpn.com/signin/product-select): Access your OpenVPN account.
- [Sign Up](https://myaccount.openvpn.com/signup): Create a new OpenVPN account.
- [OpenVPN Connect - VPN For Your Operating System](https://openvpn.net/client/): Information on the OpenVPN Connect application for various operating systems.

## Pricing

- [Access Server Pricing](https://openvpn.net/access-server/pricing/): Find out the pricing structure for OpenVPN Access Server based on business size and connections.
- [CloudConnexa Pricing](https://openvpn.net/cloud-vpn/pricing/): Find out the pricing structure for OpenVPN CloudConnexa services based on number of seats and business needs.

## Resources

- [Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) Capable Solutions](https://blog.openvpn.net/ztna-capable-solutions/): Learn about ZTNA and how it enhances security for remote access.
- [Product Comparison](https://openvpn.net/product-comparison/): Compare different OpenVPN products to find the best fit for your needs.
- [Support Portal](https://support.openvpn.com/hc/en-us): Access the OpenVPN support portal for assistance.
- [OpenVPN Blog](https://blog.openvpn.net/): Read the latest articles and updates from the OpenVPN blog.
- [Access Server Purchasing FAQ](https://openvpn.net/as-docs/faq-purchases/): Answers to common questions about buying and licensing Access Server.

## Company Information

- [Company](https://openvpn.net/about/): Learn more about OpenVPN as a company.
- [Careers](https://careers.openvpn.net/): Explore career opportunities at OpenVPN.
- [Contact](https://openvpn.net/contact/): Get in touch with OpenVPN for inquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](https://openvpn.net/privacy-policy/): Review OpenVPN's privacy policy.
- [Legal](https://openvpn.net/legal/): Access legal information related to OpenVPN services.

Network (VPN) provides your business with a securely encrypted internet connection (or “tunnel”) to securely connect devices to business assets over otherwise unsecured networks. VPNs, like OpenVPN, work by masking your IP address and encrypting your internet traffic. VPN protection is an important piece of a layered security protocol that’s essential to protecting company data as well as an employee's personal data. Using a VPN service gives you the ability to remotely access important network resources and connect your company’s branches and locations worldwide. A <a class="sc-12c5dhv-0 cWlAkt ovpn-anchor sc-1730fa58-0 kATyeM" href="/use-cases/zero-trust-network-access/"><span>zero trust VPN</span></a> offers the tenets of zero trust built on the solid foundation of a VPN.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="sc-ktyofa-4 bGLXkz ovpn-accordion ovpn-accordion--grey ovpn-accordion--md" aria-expanded="false" data-testid="accordion-item__1"><button type="button" class="sc-ktyofa-0 jPnKKt ovpn-accordion-summary"><header class="sc-ktyofa-1 gHssaR ovpn-accordion-summary__header"><span class="sc-u36d13-0 dxYmTS ovpn-text ovpn-text--display-sm ovpn-accordion-summary__title" style="color:var(--c-neutral-title)">What do VPNs do?</span></header><!--$--><!--$?--><template id="B:1"></template><svg width="24" height="24" data-testid="lazy" class="sc-1yu8hcz-0 fGRPzF"></svg><!--/$--><!--/$--></button><div class="sc-ktyofa-2 bDTwaj ovpn-accordion-details" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" data-floating-ui-focusable="" style="height:0"><div class="sc-ktyofa-3 kEaxOw ovpn-accordion-details__content"><div class="sc-db1d3218-3 ccinmS"><p class="sc-db1d3218-4 cYRaFW">VPNs encrypt traffic, protect privacy, and enable secure remote access. A <a class="sc-12c5dhv-0 cWlAkt ovpn-anchor sc-1730fa58-0 kATyeM" href="/use-cases/secure-remote-access/"><span>remote access VPN</span></a> connection secures your internet connection when you work off-site (e.g., coffee shop, hotel, airport, or even a different country), and routes all of your sensitive network traffic through an encrypted tunnel. Routing the network traffic disguises your IP address when using the internet, replacing it with the location and an IP address from the VPN server making its location invisible. A VPN connection also secures against external breaches.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="sc-ktyofa-4 bGLXkz ovpn-accordion ovpn-accordion--grey ovpn-accordion--md" aria-expanded="false" data-testid="accordion-item__2"><button type="button" class="sc-ktyofa-0 jPnKKt ovpn-accordion-summary"><header class="sc-ktyofa-1 gHssaR ovpn-accordion-summary__header"><span class="sc-u36d13-0 dxYmTS ovpn-text ovpn-text--display-sm ovpn-accordion-summary__title" style="color:var(--c-neutral-title)">What is a VPN server?</span></header><!--$--><!--$?--><template id="B:2"></template><svg width="24" height="24" data-testid="lazy" class="sc-1yu8hcz-0 fGRPzF"></svg><!--/$--><!--/$--></button><div class="sc-ktyofa-2 bDTwaj ovpn-accordion-details" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" data-floating-ui-focusable="" style="height:0"><div class="sc-ktyofa-3 kEaxOw ovpn-accordion-details__content"><div class="sc-db1d3218-3 ccinmS"><p class="sc-db1d3218-4 cYRaFW">VPNs work by routing traffic through a private server. Alternatively, you can choose a managed VPN solution, like <a class="sc-12c5dhv-0 cWlAkt ovpn-anchor sc-1730fa58-0 kATyeM" href="/cloud-vpn/"><span>CloudConnexa</span></a>, which utilizes cloud-based servers managed by OpenVPN. In any case, the VPN will route all traffic through a server.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="sc-ktyofa-4 bGLXkz ovpn-accordion ovpn-accordion--grey ovpn-accordion--md" aria-expanded="false" data-testid="accordion-item__3"><button type="button" class="sc-ktyofa-0 jPnKKt ovpn-accordion-summary"><header class="sc-ktyofa-1 gHssaR ovpn-accordion-summary__header"><span class="sc-u36d13-0 dxYmTS ovpn-text ovpn-text--display-sm ovpn-accordion-summary__title" style="color:var(--c-neutral-title)">What does a business VPN do?</span></header><!--$--><!--$?--><template id="B:3"></template><svg width="24" height="24" data-testid="lazy" class="sc-1yu8hcz-0 fGRPzF"></svg><!--/$--><!--/$--></button><div class="sc-ktyofa-2 bDTwaj ovpn-accordion-details" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" data-floating-ui-focusable="" style="height:0"><div class="sc-ktyofa-3 kEaxOw ovpn-accordion-details__content"><div class="sc-db1d3218-3 ccinmS"><p class="sc-db1d3218-4 cYRaFW">A <a class="sc-12c5dhv-0 cWlAkt ovpn-anchor sc-1730fa58-0 kATyeM" href="/use-cases/business-vpn/"><span>business VPN</span></a> creates a secure connection over the internet between your devices and your company's network. Essentially, a VPN creates a protected, encrypted tunnel through which your sensitive data can travel, providing protection from intruders and a virtual connection to your office network. ovpn-anchor sc-1730fa58-0 kATyeM" target="_blank" href="https://www.gartner.com/en/information-technology/glossary/zero-trust-network-access-ztna-"><span>Gartner</span><span class="sc-12c5dhv-1 href="https://blog.openvpn.net/ztna-capable-solutions/"><span>Zero trust network access (ZTNA)</span></a> is a product or service that creates an identity- and context-based, logical access boundary around an application or set of applications.” Doing this hides the apps from discovery and restricts access using a trust broker and a set of named entities.
